stops.title: Where Philemon lives
stops.text: A small town in the Lycus valley where a church met in Philemon's house. Onesimus is from here.

stops.title: Where Paul probably is
stops.text: Rome is not named in the letter. It is the traditional place of Paul's imprisonment; some propose Ephesus or Caesarea.
